text_blocks.snippet: Peritoneal cancer staging is similar to ovarian cancer staging, with stages ranging from 3 to 4, as early stages are rarely detected. Stage 3 indicates the cancer has spread within the peritoneal cavity, potentially to the pelvic organs, the peritoneum outside the pelvis, or retroperitoneal lymph nodes. Stage 4 signifies that the cancer has spread beyond the peritoneal cavity to distant organs like the liver, lungs, or other body parts.
